event: Routine sf0.8 restart and audit work ran in a parent build session on openai/gpt-5.6-luna instead of the local routine route.
why_chain: The parent session used cloud gpt-5.6-luna because it was started as the build agent.
It was started as build because the /continue-sf08 command hardcoded agent: build.
The command conflated baseline discovery and implementation in one continuation entrypoint.
The cost-router classified task text but only rejected routine work on complex routes; standard build/general routes remained allowed.
The routing tests explicitly documented the absence of a routine admission gate, and run evidence did not surface provider/model identity in the factory ledger.
root_cause: Continuation command selection and routing validation allowed routine work to enter a standard cloud parent session.
immediate_correction: Make continuation and predecessor recovery commands local explore sessions, add an explicit build command, and reject routine-class prompts on standard or complex agents.
root_cause_correction: Routine classification is now an admission rule, and routine cloud startup fallback is disabled so local capacity failure fails closed.
mechanical_recurrence_guard: Routing tests reject build plus status/verify text, classify operational words as deterministic, and config routing skips cloud startup fallback for routine tiers.
verification: Run npm test in ~/.config/opencode, validate configuration with opencode --version, and inspect session logs for local ollama routing on /continue-sf08.
